weekly_time_budget.description: The head coach's volume decision. reference_min is the athlete's typical week (soft); hard_cap_min is the hours the athlete gave for this week (binding).

cuts.description: What was cut to fit the cap: easy volume first, then secondary quality, long session last.

quality_session_count.description: Number of genuine quality sessions the head coach chose (<= performance_doctor.intensity_allowance.max_quality_sessions).

progression_budget.description: Which elements progress this week (max 2, max 1 run-impact) and which were held.

missed_session_policy.description: Move a missed key session only when it stays 48 h clear of the next quality or long session; otherwise drop it and repeat the rung.
